newsitem.title: CANADA: Kinross resumes underground ops at Macassa.
newsitem.headline: Kinross resumes underground ops at Macassa.

text.p: Kinross Gold Corp said on Tuesday that it resumed underground activities at its Macassa Mine Division in Kirkland Lake, Ontario after resolving some issues with the Ontario Labor Ministry.
Kinross said the ministry issued an order last week for Kinross to stop underground operations at Macassa.
Kinross had canceled underground production shifts on April 12 at Macassa after rock bursts occurred in the area of the number three shaft following a routine longhole production blast.
Kinross said more information would be available after its board meeting later this week.
